description: Declarative manifest of per-agent skill install targets, consumed by build_agent_paths() (cli/lib/skill-payload.sh) and Get-AgentPaths (cli/lib/skill-payload.ps1). Each target's path_template is relative to $HOME, with {skill_name} substituted at install time. The dynamic .claude-* multi-account discovery is NOT listed here - it scans $HOME at install time and is handled as runtime logic in both scripts. An entry with a "transform" field is a special case handled by a dedicated writer function (e.g. new_kiro_steering_file / New-KiroSteeringFile) instead of the generic folder+SKILL.md copy, and is therefore excluded from the plain path list both scripts build.
